about: The secreta of the formulary “Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord Jesus Christ, we offer You prayers and sacrificial gifts, humbly beseeching You that, as we prayerfully recall the piercing of the most sweet soul of Your blessed Mother Mary, so through the merits of Your death and the manifold intercession of her and her holy friends at the foot of the Cross, we may have our reward with the blessed. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
